steps.title: Dark adapt plants
steps.instruction: Dark adapt plants for at least 20 minutes before measurements (ideally overnight) to fully oxidize the photosynthetic electron transport chain and open reaction centres; a properly adapted healthy plant should show Fv/Fm ≈ 0.8 (values < 0.7 indicate incomplete adaptation or stress).

steps.title: Position leaf in chamber
steps.instruction: Place the leaf (or isolated plant part) so that its surface is 140 mm from the base of the imaging chamber; adjust by raising or lowering the specimen as needed.

steps.title: Set focus
steps.instruction: Adjust the focus dial above the chamber to obtain a sharp image, then lock the position by turning the side screw.

steps.title: Adjust aperture
steps.instruction: Manually adjust the aperture (as shown) to allow an optimal amount of light into the imager, avoiding over‑exposure of measurements.

steps.title: Isolate leaf region
steps.instruction: Select and isolate the plant or leaf region of interest; background areas will be masked out in blue as displayed.

steps.title: Load protocol
steps.instruction: Load the desired measurement protocol into the CF Imager software.

steps.title: Start measurement run
steps.instruction: When the scheduled program is set, click the protocol icon in the toolbar (black arrow) to start the run.
